description: This file implements the HandleBusMessage class, which processes GStreamer bus messages such as state changes, end-of-stream, and errors for a WebAudio player pipeline. It handles message parsing, state notifications, pipeline flushing, and error reporting within the Rialto media server context.

classes.name: HandleBusMessage
classes.description: A class responsible for handling GStreamer bus messages related to WebAudio playback, including state changes, end-of-stream, and errors.

methods.name: HandleBusMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the message handler with context, player, client, and pipeline message.

methods.name: ~HandleBusMessage
methods.description: Destructor that logs the cleanup of the message handler.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes the GStreamer message, updates player state, handles errors, and manages pipeline flushing.
